identifierHints.sms: Short code or long code, e.g. 55119

integration.noConfigurationsHint: Create an integration to set up API credentials, then add your phone numbers or addresses as endpoints.
integration.credentialsNoFields: No credential fields for this channel.

endpoint.title: Endpoints
endpoint.webhookNote: Webhook endpoints need no provider account — just a URL slug and a target pool. Each endpoint can optionally require a token on every trigger; without one it accepts anonymous calls from anyone who can reach it.
endpoint.noEndpoints: No endpoints yet. Click "+ Add endpoint" to add a {{channel}} number or address.
endpoint.noEndpointsStandalone: No endpoints configured. Click "+ Add endpoint" to create one.

auth.anonymousHint: Anyone who can reach this address can trigger it — no credential is checked. Generate a token to require one.

token.rotateHint: Requires X-Webhook-Token on every trigger. The token is shown once and cannot be recovered.
token.revokeHint: Removes the token AND turns authentication off — the endpoint goes back to accepting anonymous triggers.
token.rotateConfirm: Rotating invalidates the current token immediately. Any integration still using it will start failing. Continue?
token.revokeConfirm: This removes the token AND turns authentication off — the endpoint will accept anonymous triggers from anyone who can reach it. Continue?
token.freshWarning: This is the only time this token is shown. It is not stored and cannot be recovered — if you lose it, you must rotate, which invalidates this one.
token.lockNotice: The other endpoint actions stay locked until you confirm — so this token can't be mistaken for another row's.
token.lockHint: Save the token for "{{identifier}}" and confirm first — it is shown only once.

originHint.external: Registered on this screen by your team.
originHint.internal: Declared in the environment provisioning and served by an internal pool. Read-only here.
originHint.legacy_token: Migrated from the legacy token-based webhook registry.

endpoint.readOnlyHint: This endpoint comes from the environment declaration, not from this screen. Editing it here would be undone on the next platform restart — change it at the source.
endpoint.poolAddressTitle: Implicit address of every webhook pool
endpoint.poolAddressNote: Besides the identifiers above, each webhook pool can also be triggered directly by its pool id. These addresses have no registry row because they already point at the pool itself — there is nothing a row could add.

form.authRequired: Require a token on every trigger
form.authRequiredOnHint: The token is shown once, right after creating — it is never stored in clear and cannot be recovered, only rotated. Copy it before closing.
form.authRequiredOffHint: Anonymous endpoint: anyone who can reach the gateway will be able to trigger it. You can generate a token later from the list.
